content.title: How to subscribe to Detroit Tigers games on streaming services
content.text: TIGERSHow to subscribe to Tigers games on streaming servicesThe Detroit NewsMarch 26, 2026, 11:37 a.m. ETHear this storyView Comments Keep WatchingDetroit Tigers games will be streamed during the 2026 season with a new arrangement between the team and MLB Media.The new channel is called Detroit SportsNet and subscriptions are available for $189.99 for the year or $19.99 a month at tigers.com/DetroitSportsNet.For fans who prefer cable, Detroit SportsNet will be available on Comcast/Xfinity, Charter/Spectrum and DirecTV.
